_readme: Reverse index for dge/js/shabda.js's krt-form fallback (a Shabda word-tool click that misses the nominal Sabdapatha database but is actually a krdanta): surface form -> {"c": Dhatupatha root code, "k": krt pratyaya name}. Built by tools/build_krt_form_index.py from the per-root prakriya files' own "krt" array. NOT a full declension engine -- see the build script's own docstring for exactly which surface forms are generated per stem shape and which krt types are indexed only as their bare, undeclined stem. Sharded by first Devanagari codepoint, same scheme as ../formindex/.
